title: Minimum Snap Polynomial Trajectory
text: 生成经过多个路点的 minimum snap 多项式轨迹，输入 7 路、输出 8 路；按 {Minimum segment time} 指定最小时间段长度；{Show boundary conditions input ports} 指定接受边界条件输入、{Show polynomial coefficients output port} 输出多项式系数、{Show status output port} 输出状态、{Time allocation} 启用时间分配、{Time weight} 指定时间分配权重、{Maximum segment time} 指定最大时间段长度、{Maximum iterations} 指定求解器的最大迭代次数、{Maximum time} 指定求解器的最大时间、{Simulate using} 指定要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: Time
ports.summary: 沿轨迹的时间点 scalar | vector

ports.name: Waypoints
ports.summary: 沿轨迹的路点位置 n -by- p matrix

ports.name: TimePoints
ports.summary: 轨迹路点的时间点 p -element row vector

ports.name: VelBC
ports.summary: 路点的速度边界条件 n -by- p matrix

ports.name: AccelBC
ports.summary: 路点的加速度边界条件 n -by- p matrix

ports.name: JerkBC
ports.summary: 路点的加加速度边界条件 n -by- p matrix

ports.name: SnapBC
ports.summary: 路点的 snap 边界条件 n -by- p matrix

ports.name: q
ports.summary: 轨迹的位置 n -element vector | n -by- m matrix

ports.name: qd
ports.summary: 轨迹的速度 n -element vector | n -by- m matrix

ports.name: qdd
ports.summary: 轨迹的加速度 n -element vector | n -by- m matrix

ports.name: qddd
ports.summary: 轨迹的加加速度 n -element vector | n -by- m matrix

ports.name: qdddd
ports.summary: 轨迹的 snap n -element vector | n -by- m matrix

ports.name: TimeOfArrival
ports.summary: 到达每个路点的时间 p -element vector

ports.name: PolynomialCoefs
ports.summary: 多项式系数 n ( p – 1 )-by- 10 matrix

ports.name: Status
ports.summary: 轨迹生成的状态 three-element vector of the form [ SingularityStatus MaxIterStatus MaxTimeStatus ]

params.name: Show boundary conditions input ports
params.values: 接受边界条件输入 off (default) | on

params.name: Show polynomial coefficients output port
params.values: 输出多项式系数 off (default) | on

params.name: Time allocation
params.values: 启用时间分配 off (default) | on

params.name: Time weight
params.values: 时间分配权重 100 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Minimum segment time
params.values: 最小时间段长度 0.1 (default) | positive scalar | ( p – 1 )-element positive row vector

params.name: Maximum segment time
params.values: 最大时间段长度 1 (default) | positive scalar | ( p – 1 )-element positive row vector

params.name: Maximum iterations
params.values: 求解器的最大迭代次数 1500 (default) | positive integer scalar

params.name: Maximum time
params.values: 求解器的最大时间 10 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: 要运行的仿真类型 Interpreted execution (default) | Code generation
